create_clip_encoder: create a ClipEncoder instance with a specific CLIP model version and device
encode_image_clip: encode an input image as a numpy array into a CLIP feature vector
encode_text_clip: encode text strings or a list of text strings into CLIP feature vectors
get_clip_feature_dim: get the text feature dimension size for the current CLIP model version
get_clip_encoder_name: get the name string of the current CLIP encoder model version
